name: Rising
audio: a deep rumbling earth, drums building and a hawk's cry; no speech
world: The canyon is alive: red dust rolls up the walls, boulders lift and fall, condors and hawks circle, lizards dart across the rocks and heat shimmers over the sand.

actions.beat: The canyon floor trembles and splits, boulders lifting and falling, dust rolling up the red walls as condors take flight.
{{She}} rises on a heaving pillar of stone and earth, one arm raised high and the other out to {{her}} side, weight planted.
Boulders and red dust fall back in slow arcs, {{MAGIC}} light running through the cracks, as {{she}} lifts {{her}} chin and meets the camera, fierce and proud.

notes: THE DAWN, in motion: the sister rises from the Sundering in her homeland, the world moving around her.
